What insight do you want from this question?
To start — could you tell me your role, the kind of organisation you're with, and where you're based?
Open: role + org type (practitioner / funder / researcher / government / civil society / philanthropy / academia / edtech / social entrepreneur) + country (state if India)
Persona, organisation type and geographic reach.
Has InvokED shifted how you think about collective action, education leadership, or system change?
Tap: No change / Somewhat shifted / Significantly shifted
Always, once. Branch on the answer above.

If Somewhat / Significantly → What's the one idea or belief that changed for you, and what prompted it?

If No change → What would have made a real difference for you?
Magnitude of the shift and the substance behind it.

Thinking about being at InvokED — the people you met, the conversations you had — has any of it led to something substantial since? A collaboration, a pilot, funding unlocked, a partnership, a decision your team took differently?
Always, once. Branch on the answer above.

If Yes / In progress → Tell me about it — what it is, who it's with, and whether they're people you met at InvokED or already knew. And what's come of it so far?

If No → Is there a connection or an idea from InvokED you'd still like to take forward, what's holding it up, and is there anyone from InvokED you're still in touch with?

Whether InvokED led to substantial change, of what kind (collaboration / pilot / funding / partnership / decision), who it is with, whether those people were met at InvokED or already known, and what has come of it. On the No branch: latent intent, the barrier, and any continuing connection.

Beyond a formal project — has anything from InvokED travelled? An idea you took back to your team, an introduction you made between two people, something you spoke or wrote about, a way of working you changed?
Open. Expect 1 to 3 sentences. Asked of everyone, whatever they answered in Q3.
The diffuse ways InvokED reached the ecosystem — diffusion, brokered introductions, practice change, public advocacy — including from respondents who answered No to Q3.
And when did that start — within weeks of InvokED, a few months later, or further out? Is it still going?
Tap on timing: Within weeks / A few months later / Later in the year / Still unfolding. Plus tap: still going / completed / stalled.
Proof that InvokED's effect is not confined to the two days — when post-event action begins, and how much of it is still live. Anchored to whatever the respondent described in Q3 or Q4.
Has any of this shaped how your organisation works — a decision, a programme, an approach? And what changed?
Tap: Not at all / Moderately / Significantly, plus one line of open text — both in the same turn
Looking ahead — would you take part in InvokED again? And what would make staying connected through the year genuinely worth your time?
Tap: Yes / Maybe / No, plus open (forums / online problem-solving / thematic meet-ups / knowledge resources + theme)
Retention intent and the year-round engagement offer.

Last one, and it's the big one — 'future readiness' is a phrase everyone uses and almost no one defines the same way. In your work, what does it actually mean? And what are you doing that moves it forward?
Open, two parts in one turn: (a) their definition of future readiness, (b) what they are concretely doing about it. Expect 2 to 4 sentences.
How senior education leaders define future readiness and how they are contributing to it.
Maximum 10 turns per conversation. A probe counts as a turn.
Only Q2 and Q3 may probe, once each. Q1, Q4, Q5, Q6, Q7 and Q8 never spawn a follow-up.
Q4 is asked of every respondent, including those who answered No to Q3. A No in Q3 does not mean nothing happened.
Q5 is anchored to whatever the respondent described in Q3 or Q4. If both were empty, skip Q5 — the conversation ends in 9 turns.
Never re-ask something the respondent has already volunteered.
Editions attended (1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / All 5) is pre-filled from the registrant record, or collected as a tap on the post-close screen. It is not a conversational turn.

The post-close screen collects, all optional: photo upload · partner origin backstop tap (met at InvokED / already knew / a mix) · willingness to share a written or video story · Shikshagraha Awards nomination or self-nomination · best contact for follow-up.
